integration_decision.name: MAKE_ROW_B_APPEND_NONBLOCKING_AND_PHASE_WITNESSED
integration_decision.new_finding: Earlier forced-interleaving contract synchronously calls parent append_observations(rowB) while A is paused before publication. At exact source SHA, append_observations takes ArchiveWriterLock only for nonempty append and run_once does not hold it across publication. A future correct whole-run lock repair could instead hold an archive/publication lock while A is paused; synchronous parent append would then wait for A release, but the parent cannot release A until append returns: test-harness deadlock. This is a future-repair compatibility flaw in the test contract, not an executed production defect.
integration_decision.runnable_no_network_contract: At pinned SHA, spawn-safe top-level A invokes real run_once(network=False,local_dir=shared_tmp_path,as_of_ms=T) and emits A_pre_anata_write witness at patched runner.atomic_write_json(anata_latest.json), then waits on bounded release_A. Capture A's prepublication handoff as compact 0/0 evidence; do not send full anata_output. Parent starts separate top-level APPENDER child for one PIT-visible rowB (T=1700000000000, effective=T-2000, available=observed=T-1000), with append_attempted and append_done/exception witnesses and finite deadlines; NEVER synchronously block parent on append_observations. If append_done before A release, spawn B, require B's rowB handoff persisted before release_A and positive B_publish witness; then release A and assert final supported cf-anata-handoff-v1 still retains rowB (stale overwrite=RED). If appender is positively blocked on a verified whole-run publication lock, release A, require append_done then B publish rowB, verify final retention; only call serialized case PASS when lock wait and ordering are positively witnessed. If no positive interleaving or lock-wait witness, mark INCONCLUSIVE, not PASS. Always finally release_A, finite joins, terminate/join survivors, bounded Queue gets, inspect exitcodes, avoid sleeps/network. Run collect-only, targeted and full python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests in authorized exact-SHA checkout; record logs. No Specialist edits by planner.
